extends RefCounted
## Approved Willowmere HD scenery artwork.
## Stored as compact palette PNG payloads so the GitHub connector can carry the
## exact game-ready art without degrading/corrupting binary assets in transit.

const ATLAS_B64 := "" +
"" +
""

const PROPS_B64 := "" +
""

static func _decode_png(encoded: String, expected_size: Vector2i) -> Texture2D:
	var bytes: PackedByteArray = Marshalls.base64_to_raw(encoded)
	var image := Image.new()
	var err := image.load_png_from_buffer(bytes)
	if err != OK:
		push_error("Scenery PNG decode failed: %s" % err)
		return null
	if image.get_size() != expected_size:
		push_error("Scenery image size mismatch: %s expected %s" % [image.get_size(), expected_size])
		return null
	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)

static func make_atlas() -> Texture2D:
	return _decode_png(ATLAS_B64, Vector2i(512, 480))

static func make_props_sheet() -> Texture2D:
	return _decode_png(PROPS_B64, Vector2i(256, 128))
